Or cp to archives/2024_research_backup.txt directly? cp source destination: if destination is a directory, source will be copied into that directory. Destination cannot include path? It says no file paths allowed. So cp cannot use path. So we need to cd into archives then cp. Steps: cd archives, cp research_notes.txt 2024_research_backup.txt. But we need to ensure archives exists. So first check if archives exists. Use ls to see. If not, mkdir archives. Then cd archives. Then cp research_notes.txt 2024_research_backup.txt. Then cd .. back. That copies. Then maybe delete original? The instruction says "複製移動" maybe means copy and move? Might want to move original to archives? But we already copied. If we want to move original, we can mv research_notes.txt archives/2024_research_backup.txt. But mv cannot use path. So we need to cd archives then mv research_notes.txt 2024_research_backup.txt. That would rename original. But we want backup, so keep original? The phrase "複製移動" maybe means copy and move? Hard. I\'ll assume we just copy and rename.
